Our craft

Small batches, honest materials and finishes made to be touched. Here is how a piece comes together.

Oak joinery

Mortise-and-tenon frames, no screws in the load path.

Hand finishing

Sanded, oiled and waxed in three passes.

Brushed brass

Cast, brushed and left to age naturally.

Woven wool

Bouclé and kilim woven on small looms.

Glazed stoneware

Thrown, carved and fired twice.

Made to order

Shop the collection

Delivery & care

Delivery. Pieces are made to order and ship in 4–6 weeks. Free delivery over $500. Returns within 30 days if unused.

Care. Dust oak with a dry cloth and re-wax once a year. Spot-clean bouclé with mild soap. Rotate rugs twice a year. Wipe brass with a soft dry cloth.
